events.csv.name: Short title of the law or decision
events.csv.stated_intent: What proponents or the statute said it was for
events.csv.recorded_outcome: What the cited records show happened; not a causal finding
events.csv.tradeoff_or_risk: Documented cost or risk, where shown
events.csv.caveat: Limits on drawing a causal conclusion
events.csv.checked_on: ISO date a person last compared the claims with the sources

source_registry.csv.evidence_class: confirmed (found in a cited source) or unresolved (not found; not the same as false)
